decision: Option A': CCLE-anchored single-modality transcriptomic substrate. A cell line is eligible iff a CCLE baseline expression profile exists for it. All otherwise eligible drug-response observations are retained across response resources; the transcriptomic input source is standardised, the response source is not restricted. Tavor is permanently excluded on the frozen PDC provenance decision. No fallback profiles, no cross-resource averaging, no z-scoring or quantile normalisation, no expression-resource identity in D2/D4.

duplicate_rule.note: one CCLE profile per Sample_ID, asserted by build_ccle_substrate.py

scale_rule.note: single-scale by construction, no transformation applied
